criteria-binding-caveat: Criteria 1, 2 and 4 all bind to the identical command `go test ./tools/planprogress/`, so the binding cannot discriminate between them — deleting the rule-2 fixtures while keeping rule-1's would still exit 0 for criterion 2. These are result bindings (the test actually runs), not the weak grep-for-the-declaration shape, so the gap is narrow; the reviewer closed it by reading each test body and re-seeding each rule independently against a live board copy. Criterion 3's `make doc-check` binding is the strongest of the four. The same finding was raised against TASK-344 (finding 4), so this is a card-authoring pattern, not a one-off.

findings.summary: 개/건/장 are generic Korean counters; any such numeral in the same sentence as an id enumeration is read as a card count, including numerals counting fields or documents
findings.measured: 'TASK-1·2는 check.go의 Result 구조체(필드 32개)를 고친다' → '## Goal counts 32 card(s) beside an enumeration of 2'; 'TASK-1, 2, 3 — 관련 문서 8건을 정리한다' → 'scope: counts 8 card(s) beside an enumeration of 3'
findings.live-exposure: PLAN-009's body writes '필드 32개' and PLAN-007's scope writes '결함 3건'; both pass today only because the numeral and the enumeration do not share a sentence

findings.summary: A scope enumerating a counted subset plus 'and the rest' is rejected, which is PLAN-006's real shape
nearestCount hands the same count phrase to every enumeration in a sentence, producing a spurious defect on the non-adjacent one

A reversed or over-long range silently discards the separated run that follows it — the mirror image of the bug the author fixed; TestFindEnumerations/reversed_range_is_ignored locks the gap in as correct
Enumeration ids are never deduplicated, so a repeated id inflates len(ids) and can make a wrong count validate
The wiki-link form [[TASK-N]] defeats enumeration detection entirely: runTailRE requires ',' or '·' immediately after the id, and the closing ']]' interposes
findings.measured: Probe P5: Goal '[[TASK-1]], [[TASK-9]] 두 장이 남았다' with TASK-9 not a child produced 0 defects — an unreported membership violation
findings.live-exposure: [[TASK-N]] is the board's house style for cross-references; TASK-381's own body writes [[TASK-385]] and PLAN-006/007/008/009 all use the form. A plan author writing scope in house style gets no checking and no diagnostic saying so.
findings.provenance: Present in the reviewer's probe table but never numbered as a finding; promoted here by the lead.

findings.summary: Three silent parse-layer skips: folded 'scope: >' yields the literal '>', a suffixed '## Goal (2026)' yields an empty Goal, and an h1 does not terminate the Goal section

merits-summary: The measurement claim in the card's §2026-09-14 범위 재검토 holds up under independent re-derivation: the enumerate-vs-count distinction is the correct discriminator for the reason the card gives, and PLAN-008's isolated TASK-318 really is treated as context (prose.go:151, len(ids) >= 2). The asymmetry between scope: and ## Goal (compareTotal only for scope, prose.go:255-256) is load-bearing and correct for PLAN-009, whose Goal legitimately counts five of seven children. Fixtures transcribe live prose rather than minimal synthetic strings, which is why they catch the punctuation the live cards actually use. The decision NOT to mechanise the TASK-385 remainder-scope rule is documented at the point of the gap (prose.go:32-34) rather than quietly dropped. The self-reported 'range continued by a run' bug is real, fixed, and pinned by a regression test.
